Transcript of the video's audio (machine-made):
My friend lost so much money at the casino that they started letting him stay at their hotel for free. So to make sure his wife doesn't leave him, we're making her... Arayas. I hope he got savings. She might find the strength to forgive him if I add enough ground lamb in a bowl with parsley, tomato paste and a bunch of spices before grating an onion and giving it a taste of its own medicine by making it cry. I'm then dumping the onion into my bowl with grated garlic before putting on rubbers and gently massage the meat to make my friend's wife happy. It's now time to stuff her pitas with cheese and meat to make extra thick arayas that I'm brushing with olive oil and quickly searing on all sides to then finish cooking in the oven. Now people make mistakes, but to make sure she doesn't think he is the mistake, I'm slow cooking shallots, garlic and sesame seeds and olive oil to then slap yogurt on a plate with the garlic and squeezing out the shallots before adding chopped parsley and finally mushing all of it together into a garlic sauce that will save his relationship.
